notes: Fixed: a bill you had already saved stretched off the right edge of its card, squashing the name down to a sliver and pushing the tick and delete buttons off screen. The row fits properly again. Adding a new bill was never affected.
Saved bills now show their amount the same way the Add-bill row does — with a $ and thousands separators — instead of a bare number.
A saved bill now puts its name on its own line, so a name like “Car insurance premium” reads in full instead of being cut off after a few letters.

The two boxes in Your Monthly Plan were set much larger than every other field on the tab. They are still the biggest — they drive the whole plan — but no longer out of step with everything around them.
